status: EXISTS on the media buyer's side (D29: send, claim, complete; src/adapters/hermes.ts, src/adapters/telegram.ts). PROPOSED for Hermes' side and for one Telegram detail (topics).

system.name: Hermes (hooks and scenarios agent); Telegram only through the OMS

direction: Hermes PULLS from the media buyer (the media buyer is the authorization server: the same /mcp connector flow, scope mcp:videos, or the REST door with the same OAuth token). The media buyer does NOT push to Hermes and holds NO Telegram bot token: a notification goes through the OMS (`POST /api/v1/notify`).
transport_priority: 1. Hermes pulls: GET /api/v1/video-requests → claim → complete (works from anywhere, no Telegram)
2. a Telegram notification to the group topic, asked of the OMS (`oms.notify`), as a nudge only
base_url_env: HERMES_BASE_URL (push) · the media buyer's own site (pull)

pull_from_media_buyer.rule: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, exactly like the media buyer's own /mcp connector (reference implementation, public: src/core/oauth.ts + src/server/oauth.ts in the media buyer repo). The system that OWNS the data is the authorization server; the owner presses «اربط ← اسمح» once; nobody copies a token. The Bearer header on each call is unchanged.

endpoints.authorize: GET /oauth/authorize (the owner is logged in to that system and approves)
endpoints.token: POST /oauth/token (authorization_code + code_verifier S256, refresh_token with rotation)

pull_from_media_buyer.lifetimes: access token about one hour; refresh token about 60 days, rotated on every use; a revoked client or grant is refused on the very next call
pull_from_media_buyer.refused: a redirect address that was not registered, a missing or wrong PKCE verifier, a code used twice
pull_from_media_buyer.status: EXISTS — the media buyer's OAuth server (D61) already issues these; Hermes registers itself and the owner presses «اسمح» on the site
pull_from_media_buyer.replaces: the pasted «طابور التسليم» token and HERMES_TOKEN

auth.telegram: none in the media buyer. The OMS owns the bot (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN only there) and the webhook.

rate_limit: pull: 60 per minute per token; Telegram: the bot API's own limits

error_envelope.note: media buyer v1 door: {code, message}; Hermes: any 2xx is delivered, otherwise the media buyer shows `Hermes answered <status>` and keeps the request «طلب» for a retry

idempotency: A request has one id; claiming twice answers 409; completing is idempotent on (request id, v_name).

errors.when: token lacks the handoff queue / mcp:videos scope
a field outside the schema (no customer data accepted)

endpoints.notes: The new videos land in the bank as «جاهز» with their Drive ids; the owner uploads them to Meta and marks the request «مرفوع».

endpoints.change: When a video request is made, the media buyer asks the OMS to post one line to the group's «requests» topic (target {chat_id, topic_id}); advice goes to the «suggestions» topic. The ids are the owner's, saved in the media buyer's settings, never in the repo. Hermes does not depend on this message: it pulls.

example_request.text: طلب جديد: هوكات جديدة — TRF01 / JOB-12

errors.when: the OMS bot is not in that group or the topic does not exist

endpoints.size: small — it is the OMS's endpoint (see oms.notify); the media buyer side is one adapter

media_buyer.NOTIFY_HERMES_REQUESTS_TARGET: chat -1001234567890 · topic 1001 (kept in the media buyer's settings page, not in the repo)
media_buyer.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: (external secret — entered on the site's tokens page, never pasted into another system)
media_buyer.note: no bot token and no Hermes token in the media buyer

hermes.note: stores its OAuth token for the media buyer itself

$comment: Written by the media buyer (docs/INTEGRATION_CONTRACTS.md). A published version never breaks: only optional fields are added; a removed, renamed or retyped field is v2. No customer name, phone or address in any field, under any name.
